decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service remains distant from the maritime core and has shown no reported results after two years, but it runs on the existing recruitment network at low cost, so the option stays open for now while its value is still unproven.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's crewing and training infrastructure, costs little to maintain and supports the move into integrated maritime services.
The Smart Academy grew quickly to six partner institutions within months, which signals real value and justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
FuelEU monitoring and compliance is a regulatory necessity, and the firm met the 2024 deadline for all vessels, so its value is largely confirmed and demand will grow.
The FuelEU dashboard is integrated into the existing PAL software, so it costs little to keep, and the start of FuelEU in 2025 makes its value likely to be realized.
The cost simulation tool is cheap to keep inside PAL and gives clients options for planning FuelEU compliance, but its separate value is less proven, so it remains a low-cost option to keep open.
